title: Sega Flash Vol. 2
overview:
Volume 2 of Sega's European Sega Flash demo disc series, offering a sampler of Saturn games.

Playable demos:
- Nights into Dreams...
- Sega Worldwide Soccer '97
- Athlete Kings
- Panzer Dragoon Zwei
- Baku Baku

Non-playable demos:
- Virtua Fighter Kids
- The Story of Thor 2
- Three Dirty Dwarves
- Exhumed
